known_disagreements.subject: Abul Hasan 2026 author display
evidence: Rokomari identifies Dr. Mohammod Abul Hasan.
eBoighar identifies Dr. Abul Hasan Chowdhury.
known_disagreements.disposition: Do not normalize the exact 2026 author/imprint identity until the physical title/imprint page is inspected.

known_disagreements.subject: Abul Hasan authorization lineage versus later edition changes
evidence: Public reporting says the book was NCTB-approved in 1998 and again in 2013.
The same reporting quotes the publisher describing later expanded editions and raises whether later content exactly matches the approved manuscript.
known_disagreements.disposition: Treat approval as book-family lineage only; exact current edition authorization remains pending.

known_disagreements.subject: B13 engine scope versus photographed Chapter 10
evidence: B13 includes plant growth, hormones and reproduction.
The authenticated Chapter 10 mapping supports reproduction but does not establish the growth/hormone facets.
known_disagreements.disposition: Keep growth and hormone facets explicitly unmapped.

known_disagreements.subject: Gazi Ajmol 2026 revision authorization identity
evidence: The physical edition page shows a 2014 current-syllabus publication as NCTB-approved and a 2026 revised edition.
No separate 2026 approval number is visible in the supplied image.
known_disagreements.disposition: Use 2026 as inspected revision; preserve 2014 as visible approved current-syllabus lineage.

known_disagreements.subject: HSC representative-animal scope versus Higher Zoology reuse
evidence: Authenticated HSC Chapter 2 scope is Hydra, grasshopper/Poekilocerus and Rohu/Labeo.
Existing Higher Zoology includes several additional representative animals.
known_disagreements.disposition: Only Labeo is direct reuse candidate; other Higher Zoology animals remain supplemental.
